rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ShieldOps is an autonomous Security Operations Center (SOC) built on the Archestra platform. It bundles three specialized servers: incident-db for PostgreSQL-backed incident lifecycle and evidence chain management, threat-intel for lookups against AbuseIPDB, VirusTotal, and NVD, and security-playbook for containment actions and playbook execution. Five coordinated agents (Sentinel, Sherlock, Overseer, Responder, Chronicler) use these tools to triage alerts, investigate indicators, execute containment, and produce compliance-ready reports.
